chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Qurashi narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad [ibn Isa] narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said: My father narrated to me, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them), who said: The Messenger of Allah (Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family) said:
It has dropped unto you the disease of the nations before you: hatred and jealousy.

key_terms.الحسد: Jealousy/Envy (desiring the removal of blessings from others)

ai.seo_question: What is the disease of the nations mentioned in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this chain tracing back to Imam al-Rida and Imam Ali, framing hatred and envy not merely as personal sins but as the systemic 'disease' that caused the collapse of prior civilizations. This hadith serves as a diagnostic tool in Shia ethical scholarship, urging believers to purify the heart from these internal corrosives to maintain the spiritual and social integrity of the Ummah.
